source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 5 mathematics textbooks

stages.headline: The position of each digit is called a place. Places are counted from right to left.
stages.headlineEnglish: The position of each digit is called a place. Places are counted from right to left.

stages.headline: Place units are 1, 10, 100, 1 000, ... each 10 times the previous one.
stages.headlineEnglish: Place units are 1, 10, 100, 1 000, ... each 10 times the previous one.

stages.headline: Places of large numbers are grouped in threes from the right; each group is a class.
stages.headlineEnglish: Places of large numbers are grouped in threes from the right; each group is a class.

stages.headline: Which digit is in the hundred-thousands place of 7 254 091?
stages.headlineEnglish: Which digit is in the hundred-thousands place of 7 254 091?
stages.problemText: Which digit is in the hundred-thousands place of 7 254 091?
stages.solutionSteps: 1. The thousands class is 254. 2. Its highest place, hundred-thousands, holds 2.
stages.solutionStepsEnglish: 1. The thousands class is 254. 2. Its highest place, hundred-thousands, holds 2.

stages.headline: Write the number with 2 in the millions place, 5 in the thousands place and zeros elsewhere.
stages.headlineEnglish: Write the number with 2 in the millions place, 5 in the thousands place and zeros elsewhere.
stages.problemText: Write the number with 2 in the millions place, 5 in the thousands place and zeros elsewhere.

stages.headline: How many thousands are there in 12 500 000 altogether?
stages.headlineEnglish: How many thousands are there in 12 500 000 altogether?
stages.problemText: How many thousands are there in 12 500 000 altogether?
stages.solutionSteps: 1. Drop the units class (000). 2. 12 500 thousands remain.
stages.solutionStepsEnglish: 1. Drop the units class (000). 2. 12 500 thousands remain.
